title: Luisa Santiago Wolf
text:
CV
  

  
  
I am a PhD candidate in Economics at the University of Cologne, a member of ECONtribute and C-SEB, and an associated member of DIW Berlin.
My main research fields are labor and education economics.
I have visited the Department of Economics at Uppsala University in Spring 2025, hosted by Peter Fredriksson.
Email: santiago-wolf@wiso.uni-koeln.de
